newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat firms, future prices down.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat firms, future prices down.

text.p: Argentine wheat firmed in tight cash market morning trade at the Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, although futures prices slipped, traders slipped.

"There wasn't anyone selling in the morning, so prices slipped," one trader said, adding that the future market was being driven by perceptions that the crop weather was improving. Cash March wheat rose $6 to $146, farmer price.

But March fell $2.50 on the futures market to $144.50. April cash maize firmed in slow trade by $2 to $97, supported by export sales and a higher Chicago market. March cash sunseed firmed $2 to $212, bouyed by concern over northern crop weather.
